name: agrinews-autotest
description: Automation test suite — E2E specs run inside the playwright Docker container; unit/component tests run in backend/frontend containers.

scripts.test:integration: docker exec agrinews-backend-1 npm run test:integration
scripts.test:e2e: docker exec agrinews-playwright-1 npx playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:headed: docker exec agrinews-playwright-1 npx playwright test --headed
scripts.test:coverage:backend: docker exec agrinews-backend-1 npm run test:coverage
scripts.test:coverage:frontend: docker exec agrinews-frontend-1 npm run test:coverage
